posts.context: The 30-year-old body requires maintenance that is sold as wellness but acts as basic damage control.
posts.angle: The gym is no longer about looking good or looking healthy. It is a repayment plan for the damage done in your early twenties.
slides: Your corporate gym membership is no longer an aspiration.

At 22: Bench press.
At 27: Cardio zone.
At 32: Core stabilization for lower back compression.

It is not fitness.

It is a monthly installment on your twenties.
posts.caption: Somebody you know is currently researching orthopaedic insoles like they are high-tech sneakers.
